aiDecision.thesis: A 20,187-transaction EOA routing $1.55M of SHIB to Binance through an intermediate deposit address looks like routine operational/market-maker flow, not holder distribution. The block is ~1.4% of SHIB's $108M daily volume and 0.026% of supply, implying only a 0.42% impact that barely clears the cost floor.
aiDecision.rationale: High transaction count and full-balance sweep via a dedicated deposit address are the signature of a hot/market-maker wallet cycling inventory, not a holder liquidating. Size is immaterial against SHIB's liquidity, modeled 0.418% sits essentially on the 0.411% minimum edge, and the market has not moved at all, so there is no confirmation of pressure. Direction is unjudgeable; stand aside.
